# Form

`ui.form` · parts: `Form` · elements: `<form>`

## Purpose

Form is the native <form>. Submission, validation and state are the consumer's;
the primitive only types the native form attributes.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- One path for forms: use `Form`; `Box` no longer accepts `tag="form"` (it falls back to `div`).
- `method` is whitelisted case-insensitively to `get | post | dialog` and printed lowercase; any
  other value (e.g. `put`) omits the attribute (the browser default `get` applies).
- `novalidate` is a boolean attribute (present/absent). `action`, `enctype`, `autocomplete`,
  `target`, `name`, `id` are forwarded verbatim; empty strings are omitted.
- No implicit role: a `<form>` is a landmark only when named — pass `aria-label` /
  `aria-labelledby` for that. Submission, validation and state stay with the consumer
  (`onSubmit` via rest props / `attrs`).
- Layout with tokens and the 8+4 grid, e.g. `class="grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground"`.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Form renders a native form element; method is whitelisted (get|post|dialog).

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ID` | `id` | `id` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Name` | `name` | `name` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Action` | `action` | `action` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | submission URL |
| `Method` | `method` | `method` | `"get" \| "post" \| "dialog"` | — | prop | HTTP method: get \| post \| dialog (omitted when empty) |
| `Enctype` | `encType` | `enctype` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | encoding for post (e.g. multipart/form-data) |
| `NoValidate` | `noValidate` | `novalidate` | `boolean` | — | prop | skip native constraint validation |
| `Autocomplete` | `autoComplete` | `autocomplete` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | on \| off |
| `Target` | `target` | `target` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | browsing context for the response |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaLabelledBy` | `aria-labelledby` | `aria-labelledby` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaDescribedBy` | `aria-describedby` | `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `formClasses({ ... })` from `form/form.shared.ts` |
| templ | `form.FormClasses(form.FormProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('formClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::formClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `form_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<form>Content</form>` |
| post | `{"Action":"/login","Method":"post","Name":"login","Autocomplete":"on","AriaLabel":"Sign in","Class":"grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground"}` | `<form class="grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground" name="login" action="/login" method="post" autocomplete="on" aria-label="Sign in">Content</form>` |
| upload | `{"Action":"/upload","Method":"POST","Enctype":"multipart/form-data","NoValidate":true,"Target":"_self","ID":"upload"}` | `<form id="upload" action="/upload" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" novalidate target="_self">Content</form>` |
| dialog | `{"Method":"dialog"}` | `<form method="dialog">Content</form>` |
| rejected | `{"Method":"put"}` | `<form>Content</form>` |
| Method=get | `{"Method":"get"}` | `<form method="get">Content</form>` |
| Method=post | `{"Method":"post"}` | `<form method="post">Content</form>` |
| Method=dialog | `{"Method":"dialog"}` | `<form method="dialog">Content</form>` |
| NoValidate | `{"NoValidate":true}` | `<form novalidate>Content</form>` |

## Usage

Fixture `post` (`{"Action":"/login","Method":"post","Name":"login","Autocomplete":"on","AriaLabel":"Sign in","Class":"grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<form class="grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground" name="login" action="/login" method="post" autocomplete="on" aria-label="Sign in">Content</form>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Form } from "./ui/form/form";

<Form method="post" className="grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground" action="/login" name="login" autoComplete="on" aria-label="Sign in">Content</Form>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Form from "./ui/form/Form.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Form method="post" class="grid gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground" action="/login" name="login" autocomplete="on" aria-label="Sign in">Content</Form>
</template>
```
